-- Fetch hackathon registrations
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'registration_id', r.id,
      'hackathon_id', h.id,
      'hackathon_name', h.name,
      'mode', h.mode,
      'location', h.location,
      'prize_pool', h.prize_pool,
      'start_date', h.start_date,
      'end_date', h.end_date,
      'website_url', h.website_url,
      'registration_status', r.status,
      'looking_for_team', r.looking_for_team,
      'registered_at', r.created_at
    ) ORDER BY h.start_date DESC NULLS LAST
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_registrations
  FROM public.hackathon_registrations r
  JOIN public.hackathons h ON h.id = r.hackathon_id
  WHERE r.user_id = v_user_uuid
    AND COALESCE(r.is_hidden, false) = false;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_pending_deadline_reminders()
 RETURNS TABLE(saved_id uuid, user_id uuid, user_email text, user_name text, hackathon_id uuid, hackathon_name text, registration_end timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    sh.id AS saved_id,
    sh.user_id AS user_id,
    p.email::TEXT AS user_email,
    p.full_name::TEXT AS user_name,
    h.id AS hackathon_id,
    h.name::TEXT AS hackathon_name,
    h.registration_end AS registration_end
  FROM public.saved_hackathons sh
  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = sh.user_id
  JOIN public.hackathons h ON h.id = sh.hackathon_id
  LEFT JOIN public.hackathon_registrations hr ON hr.hackathon_id = sh.hackathon_id AND hr.user_id = sh.user_id
  WHERE 
    sh.reminder_sent_at IS NULL
    AND hr.id IS NULL -- Only builders who have NOT registered yet
    AND h.registration_end IS NOT NULL
    AND h.registration_end >= NOW()
    AND h.registration_end <= NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours';

CREATE TABLE public.hustle_phase2_batches (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  event_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT '0da43cba-90dc-449c-a126-a2fc8be8a379' REFERENCES public.hackathons(id),
  source_digest text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (source_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  imported_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  imported_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
  row_count integer NOT NULL CHECK (row_count BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
  activated_at timestamptz,
  CHECK (event_id = '0da43cba-90dc-449c-a126-a2fc8be8a379')
);

CREATE TABLE public.hustle_phase2_teams (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  event_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT '0da43cba-90dc-449c-a126-a2fc8be8a379' REFERENCES public.hackathons(id),
  batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.hustle_phase2_batches(id),
  external_team_id text NOT NULL CHECK (external_team_id ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{0,63}$'),
  team_name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(team_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  leader_name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(leader_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  leader_email text NOT NULL CHECK (length(leader_email) <= 254 AND leader_email = lower(btrim(leader_email)) AND leader_email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$'),
  leader_whatsapp text CHECK (leader_whatsapp ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'),
  second_member_name text CHECK (length(second_member_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND lower(second_member_name) <> lower(leader_name)),
  decision text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (decision IN ('pending','confirmed','declined')),
  decided_at timestamptz,
  CHECK ((decision = 'pending') = (decided_at IS NULL)),
  CHECK (event_id = '0da43cba-90dc-449c-a126-a2fc8be8a379'),
  UNIQUE(event_id, external_team_id), UNIQUE(event_id, leader_email), UNIQUE(event_id, leader_whatsapp)
);

CREATE POLICY hackathon_announcements_insert ON public.hackathon_announcements
FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (
  organizer_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
  AND public.can_access_partner_event(hackathon_announcements.hackathon_id)
  AND (public.has_partner_admin_access() OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.hackathons AS h WHERE h.id = hackathon_announcements.hackathon_id
      AND h.type = 'native' AND h.organizer_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
  ))
);

      'hackathon_id', h.id,

      'prize_pool', h.prize_pool,
      'start_date', h.start_date,

      'website_url', h.website_url
    ) || CASE WHEN v_caller = v_user_uuid THEN jsonb_build_object(

    ) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END ORDER BY h.start_date DESC NULLS LAST
  ), '[]'::jsonb)

  WHERE r.user_id = v_user_uuid
